related.title: cuBLAS 與 Tensor Core：補齊形狀的有效利用率
related.titleEn: cuBLAS and Tensor Cores: useful work after padding
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：非對稱索引正確，誤差門檻預先明定，工作量與效能數據使用相同 FLOP 慣例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Asymmetric indexing is correct, error limits are declared beforehand, and work and performance use one FLOP convention.
related.difference: 以有效元素及補齊元素的分母差異評估利用率，而不是只比較核心計時。
related.differenceEn: Evaluate utilization with distinct useful and padded denominators rather than kernel timing alone.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: C=AB，A 為 M×K、B 為 K×N；約 2MNK FLOP 採每次乘及加各算一次的慣例。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 M=N=16，K=32；兩輸入為 16 bit，累加器為 32 bit。 MAC=16×16×32=8192；F=2×8192=16384 FLOP。這是工作量，未包含搬移或啟動時間。
固定 K 時，補齊矩陣的有用運算比例為 MN/(MpNp)。補零不改變保留區的數學答案。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 M=130、N=70、K=64；教學核心要求 M、N 為 16 的倍數，因此補到 144×80。 有效比例=130×70/(144×80)=0.7899306，即 78.9931%。此 16 倍數是教學核心限制，非所有 cuBLAS 版本通則。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For C=AB with M×K and K×N inputs, approximately 2MNK FLOPs counts one multiply and one add per MAC. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. M=N=16, K=32; inputs use 16 bits and accumulators 32 bits. MACs=16×16×32=8192; F=2×8192=16384 FLOPs, excluding transfers and launch time.

At fixed K, useful-work fraction is MN/(MpNp); zero padding preserves the retained mathematical output. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. M=130, N=70, K=64; a teaching kernel uses multiples of 16, padding to 144×80. Useful fraction=130×70/(144×80)=0.7899306 or 78.9931%; the multiple-of-16 rule belongs to this teaching kernel.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Cerebras WSE：晶圓尺度圖分割與邊界流量
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：非對稱索引正確，誤差門檻預先明定，工作量與效能數據使用相同 FLOP 慣例。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Asymmetric indexing is correct, error limits are declared beforehand, and work and performance use one FLOP convention.
related.difference: 保持運算圖不變，計算不同放置方式跨區資料量，找出高頻邊應靠近的理由。
related.differenceEn: Hold the graph fixed and calculate cross-region traffic under different placements.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: C=AB，A 為 M×K、B 為 K×N；約 2MNK FLOP 採每次乘及加各算一次的慣例。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 M=N=16，K=32；兩輸入為 16 bit，累加器為 32 bit。 MAC=16×16×32=8192；F=2×8192=16384 FLOP。這是工作量，未包含搬移或啟動時間。
邊界流量等於每條跨區邊的張量大小乘呼叫頻率後加總；節點數平均不代表流量最小。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 四條跨區邊各傳2 MiB，每秒1000次；局部性調整後僅兩條跨區，無資料壓縮。 流量=4×2×1000=8000 MiB/s；只計單向資料，不含封包或路由開銷。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For C=AB with M×K and K×N inputs, approximately 2MNK FLOPs counts one multiply and one add per MAC. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. M=N=16, K=32; inputs use 16 bits and accumulators 32 bits. MACs=16×16×32=8192; F=2×8192=16384 FLOPs, excluding transfers and launch time.

Cut traffic sums tensor bytes times call frequency over crossing edges; equal node counts do not minimize traffic. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Four crossing edges carry2 MiB each at 1000 calls/s; remapping leaves two crossing edges, without compression. Traffic=4×2×1000=8000 MiB/s, counting one-way payload only.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
